items.quote: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying
items.claim: Abimelech and Phichol spoke to Abraham
items.actor: Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host

items.quote: God is with thee in all that thou doest
items.claim: God is with Abraham in all his undertakings

items.quote: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son
items.claim: Abimelech demands Abraham swear by God not to deal falsely with him and his descendants

items.quote: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned
items.claim: Abraham will reciprocate kindness to Abimelech and his land
items.place: the land wherein thou hast sojourned
